messages:
Marco (sales): heads up — BlueHarbor just escalated: their production traffic saw a ~30% throughput drop starting 02:10 UTC after last night's rollout. Customer says throughput fell but latency for individual requests looks stable.
Jenna (product): thanks — do we have telemetry links or a quick summary? is this limited to BlueHarbor or observed elsewhere?
Marco (sales): only BlueHarbor so far, they ran a sustained load test and hit queueing. sent logs to support.
Rachel (support): attached logs show queue depth spikes on their tenant id bh-482. I'll paste the key snippet: `queued_requests ~= 0.28 * inflight` over 02:12-02:20.
Sam (eng-runtime): interesting — that ratio suggests batching/autoscale didn't keep up. any recent kernel/kv-cache changes in the 02:00 deploy?
Alex (eng-platform): we pushed a runtime tweak to batching thresholds in canary at 01:45 for cpu/gpu pooling. Canary finished at 01:58 and rolled to prod at 02:00 per deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: release/2024-11-17/infra-batching applied to all regions at 02:00 UTC.
Priya (oncall): I'm pulling traces now. quick check: BlueHarbor traffic pattern uses many medium-length prompts so batch sizes climb unpredictably. If batching thresholds increased, it could cause queuing while waiting for batches.
Sam (eng-runtime): plausible. mitigation idea: temporarily revert batching threshold to previous value via routing rule or config flag for bh-482. I can prepare a hotfix to set `batch_wait_ms=8` for that tenant.
Jenna (product): decision: we need two tracks — immediate mitigation for customer SLA, and a postmortem + eval for rollout criteria. Marco: convey we will escalate priority and propose targeted rollback for bh-482.
Marco (sales): they want a timeline. can we give 2 hours for mitigation and ETA for full fix?
Sam (eng-runtime): can do hotfix + targeted config in ~45m. rollback of the global change is higher impact; prefer tenant-level exception.
Alex (eng-platform): I can route bh-482 to the previous model variant pool (variant:v1) for 30m window while runtime applies config. command: `POST /routing/override {"tenant":"bh-482","pool":"variant:v1","ttl":1800}`
Priya (oncall): I'll run the override and monitor. creating alert: `alert bh-482 queue_depth > 50 for 2m` and slack notify #eng-oncall.
Rachel (support): I told BlueHarbor we're doing a targeted change and will confirm within an hour. they appreciated the quick reply.
Jenna (product): backlog action: create a product ticket to update rollout launch criteria — require targeted perf eval with representative tenant load tests + canary window of 2h with queue/throughput checks. Acceptance criteria: no >10% throughput degradation for a representative tenant and automated rollback gate.
Sam (eng-runtime): I'll add a tech task: tenant-exceptions + runtime config flags UI + telemetry dashboard panel for per-tenant queueing. estimate: 3 dev-days.
Alex (eng-platform): platform task: expose `route_override` as a safe self-serve operation for SRE/product with audit logs. estimate: 2 dev-days + 1 day review.
Jenna (product): prioritize this as P1 for the next sprint planning runway given revenue impact. we'll scope MVP to tenant-level overrides, canary perf gating, and a short runbook.
Marco (sales): noting impact for renewal conversation — appreciate the rapid plan.
Priya (oncall): override applied at 02:35 UTC. initial metrics show queue depth dropping. monitoring for 20m.
Sam (eng-runtime): hotfix deployed at 02:54 UTC (set `batch_wait_ms=8` for bh-482).
Rachel (support): BlueHarbor confirmed throughput recovered after the change. they requested a postmortem and permanent fix cadence.
Jenna (product): thanks team. I'll open the product ticket with the acceptance criteria and link the runbook + incident notes. action owners: Sam (runtime fixes), Alex (platform routing + UI), Priya (monitoring/runbook), Rachel (customer comms).
Marco (sales): passing update to BlueHarbor contacts and scheduling postmortem call.
Jenna (product): postmortem invite tentative for tomorrow 15:00 UTC. agenda: timeline, root cause, rollout criteria changes, customer impact and follow-ups.
Priya (oncall): adding traces and graphs to the doc. closing this slack thread once postmortem notes are linked. :white_check_mark:
